title: The Counterattack
dialogue: Vyktor arrives before the morning briefing. That is never a good sign.
monologue: He only comes early when something cannot wait for the scheduled hour.

narrative.text: Kolvar filed a formal Assembly motion last night. He is calling for a parliamentary review of the new government's constitutional mandate — specifically your authority to pursue reforms without Assembly supermajority approval. It is procedurally weak but politically loud.
He is not trying to win this motion. He is trying to make you spend political capital defending yourself instead of governing. That is the attack.

vyktor_counterattack_brief.monologue: He is right. This is not a legal challenge — it is a calendar attack. Every hour I spend responding to Kolvar's motion is an hour not spent on the budget, the BNI, the cabinet. He is trying to govern through obstruction.

choices.text: Have Justice prepare a formal rebuttal. Fight it on the procedural merits.
Do not respond. Govern. Let the motion die without oxygen.
